As a result, multiplying (in “Low” cases) or dividing (in “High” cases) a model value by a factor will result in the measured value. All EPIcode results are within a factor of 1.0–4.1(High) of the measured values for plume centerline concentrations. This range is consistent with both DEGADIS (high by a factor of 1.0– 10) and SLAB (low by a factor of 2.0–3.5). All EPIcode and DEGADIS results were consistently higher than measured and numerically consistent as well at 0.8 km. Table 3.4.
